text: Idea cursor: j/k walk the visible rows of the list
description: Slice 1 of 562cdb60. getVisibleIdeaRows (navigation-helpers) derives the rendered rows (top-level ideas plus children of expanded ideas, as index paths). navigateDown/Up step one row through list-store getIdeaListScope/selectIdeaRow/stepIdeaRow. Crossing a phase boundary enters at the first row going down and the last visible row going up. Replaces the per-level selectedIncomingIndex juggling, goToLastChildIdea, and the stale-index condition. Cursor state is still encoded as selectedIdeaIndex/floatingIdeaIndex plus the selectedIncomingIndex chain; replacing that is slice 3.

status.comment: Implemented and unit-tested; needs Felix to try j/k through expanded ideas in the list view (behavior change: j now enters an expanded idea's children).
